independentDefinitions: English short scale: thousand=10^3, million=10^6, billion=10^9; double/twice=2, half=1/2.
Unicode CLDR release-48 common/rbnf/ja.xml, zh.xml, ko.xml: 万/만=10^4 and 億/亿/억=10^8. No CLDR runtime/data package is bundled.
conventions: Compact suffixes k/K/M/B attach to a number. Full English multipliers are case-insensitive. CJK compound groups descend by scale; only their final group can be fractional. Prefix word operators preserve percentages; declared names/function calls keep their role.
